title: Causal & Conditional Linkages: Mivel, Tekintettel arra & Feltéve

sections.title: Causal and Conditional Formulations
sections.content: Causal and conditional clauses articulate complex logic: *mivel* (since, inasmuch as), *tekintettel arra, hogy* (in view of the fact that), and *feltéve, ha / feltéve, hogy* (provided that).

items.spanish: Mivel minden adat rendelkezésre áll, megalapozott döntést hozhatunk.
items.english: Since all data is available, we can make an informed decision.

items.spanish: Tekintettel arra, hogy az idő sürget, azonnal cselekednünk kell.
items.english: In view of the fact that time is pressing, we must act immediately.

items.spanish: A szerződés érvényes, feltéve, hogy mindkét fél aláírja.
items.english: The contract is valid, provided that both parties sign it.
